items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: you and Arnie, you were talented -- you were personalities, both of you... My brother is two years and four months younger than I

ctx.x: Well, I just don't know. The only thing I can say, Helen, was I was aware of music at the age of eight.
Well, now, you see, there you are and there's Arnie, your brother, both of you extraordinarily talented, so now where is this^-- you had no sisters.
